tenderSchedule.title: Scanning, Indexing, Cataloguing, Digitization Of Historical Records and Computer Output Microfilm rolls
tenderSchedule.description: Scanning, Indexing, Cataloguing, Digitization Of Historical Records and Computer Output Microfilm rolls of Karnataka State Archives and Gazetteer Department for the FY 2026-27, 2027-28, 2028-29

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
ALL TERMS AND CONDITION AS PER THE TENDER DOCUMENT

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder must provide details and descriptions of prior data entry, scanning, encapsulation, digitization, and Computer Output Microfilm (COM) jobs executed for clients, including client names and total project values. The bidder must have specifically undertaken the digitization of records in archives.

The bidder must possess data entry and scanning infrastructure including computers, printers, UPS systems, standard scanners, digital microfilm converters, and microfilm scanners with a minimum total value of 50.00 Lakhs. The bidder must mandatorily own a latest-model scanner and an overhead A2-size book scanner equipped with CCD technology.

The bidder must have an average annual financial turnover of 2.00 Crore (Rupees Two Crore) or more during the last three financial years from Data Entry, Document Management (indexing, metadata tagging/keyword search), and Computer Output Microfilm (COM) services, with a minimum turnover of 50.00 Lakhs in each of those three financial years.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder must submit Income Tax Returns (ITR) filed along with audited financial statements for the last three financial years.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: The company should have minimum of 50 data entry operators on roll
